project_metadata.name: MWCREW
project_metadata.archetype: Luxury (5) + Swiss & High-Contrast (4) for a premium BMW M automotive aesthetic
project_metadata.description: Exclusive automotive event registration site for a 25-car limit MWCREW rally.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-8xl tracking-tight uppercase font-heading
hierarchy.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight uppercase font-heading
hierarchy.overline: text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-mono text-zinc-400

accents.usage: Use these three BMW M colors EXTREMELY sparingly. E.g., a tiny 3px decorative line on top of the hero, or as a subtle hover border on the submit button. NEVER use as large backgrounds.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Massive negative space. Cinematic, moody. Grid layouts for gallery. Forms should look technical and strict.
layout_and_spacing.sections: Use generous vertical spacing (py-24 or py-32) between major sections.

components.buttons: Square edges. High contrast. Default: bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200. Add tactile click animations.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI heavily customized. Minimalist dark theme: bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-800 text-white focus:border-white focus:ring-0. Square corners. No heavy shadows.
components.cards: Flat, sharp edges, 1px subtle border (border-zinc-800/50), no drop shadows, background very dark grey (#121212).

hero_bg.description: Dark, moody texture for hero background.
hero_bg.usage: Background image for hero section. Ensure it has a black gradient overlay (e.g. bg-black/60) to make white text completely legible.

gallery_edition_1.description: First edition cars at a roundabout.
gallery_edition_1.usage: Use in 'Éditions Précédentes' gallery. Label as 'Édition 1'.

gallery_edition_2.usage: Use in 'Éditions Précédentes' gallery. Label as 'Édition 2'.

core_features: Hero section featuring 'MWCREW', 'Édition 3', '19 Juillet', 'Lac de l\'Eau d\'Heure'.
A prominent counter displaying '25 PLACES LIMITÉES'.
Gallery section displaying Édition 1 and Édition 2 using the provided media URLs.

Registration Form containing these fields: Prénom, Modèle BMW, Photo de la voiture (upload/file input), Numéro de téléphone, Intérêt pour les prochaines éditions (Radio or Checkbox: '1 journée (visites, restaurant)' vs '2 jours (avec hôtel)').
Success state displayed after successful form submission.
Admin Page (route /admin) protected by a simple password (mocked or simple env check) to view a table of all registrations.
functional_requirements.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, forms) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Oswald, IBM Plex Mono, and Manrope fonts.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the landing page layout and Shadcn UI (customized to be dark/minimalist) for the form elements.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000) for the background, use #0A0A0A.
Ensure the hero background image has sufficient overlay (e.g., bg-black/60) to maintain high contrast for the text.
Implement the 25 places limit logic (can mock the database for now if backend not fully setup, but define the state clearly).
